text:
emily: Hey folks — random idea: taco truck + pop-up ping-pong micro-tourney this Friday 6pm in the alley courtyard. Casual, prizes, and an icebreaker bingo to keep things silly. Who's in? :taco: :table_tennis:

ryan: Love that. Can we do a quick 10-min warmup session for people who haven't played before?

emily: Definitely. We'll run a 6:05 beginner mini-clinic. No pressure.

jasmine: I can bring a spare paddle and some tape for makeshift boundaries. Also vote: food truck or order-in tacos?

owen: Truck is more fun. Echo: tacos + street-style sides.

priya: In! I can make a small "quirky icebreaker" card set (questions) and a bingo sheet for mingling.

emily: @jasmine @owen sounds like truck then. Quick poll: react with :taco_truck: for truck, :pizza: for order-in, :bento: if you want vegetarian-only options prioritized.

ryan: :taco_truck: :bento:

jasmine: :taco_truck:

owen: :taco_truck:

priya: :bento: :taco_truck:

emily: Great — taco truck + veg options. Food-bot can you suggest local trucks that do veg tacos?

food-bot: Suggested vendors: "La Calle MT", "Sol y Sazon" (veg options), "TacoSprints" (fast). Link: https://vendors.example.com/tacos

jasmine: Sol y Sazon does a great roasted cauliflower taco. I'll DM to confirm availability.

ryan: Logistics q: court/table count? How many tables will we have for ping-pong?

emily: I can borrow 2 foldable tables from events closet and owen offered a small net. That should be fine for a bracket of 8-ish.

owen: I'll bring the net + a small scoreboard chalkboard.

priya: I'll bring bingo cards and a tiny prize box for random winners (stickers, tiny gift cards).

jasmine: Dietary note: I'm allergic to shellfish. I'll add that to the food contact.

emily: Noted. We'll tell the vendor. Also please label anything people bring.

ryan: Can we set expectations on end time? I have an evening call at 8:30.

emily: Plan is 6:00-8:15 max. If people want to linger after that's fine but we'll aim to wrap matches and prize ceremony by 8:15.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Taco Truck + Ping-Pong Micro-Tourney" Fri 18:00 — reminder at 15:00. Venue: Courtyard.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Courtyard Tacos & Ping-Pong" Fri 18:00 — guest list updated. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2532109876

jasmine: I'll confirm truck at 4pm and post the menu options here. Also, can someone grab ice? I can take drinks if needed.

owen: I can pick up ice and a box of napkins around 5:15.

priya: I'll volunteer to run the icebreaker bingo at 6:20, quick 10-minute mingle.

emily: Nice. One more poll for prizes: react :gift: for small gift cards, :medal: for funny trophies, :beer: for beer vouchers.

ryan: :gift:

jasmine: :medal:

owen: :medal:

priya: :gift: (but also medals for runner-up?)

emily: Looks like gift cards + medals. I'll handle prize procurement.

jasmine: Menu from Sol y Sazon: cauliflower al pastor, black bean & sweet potato, cactus slaw, chips + guac. They can do a GF corn tortilla option. Link: https://solysazon.example/menu.pdf

ryan: Perfect. Any volunteers to help ferry tables/truck supplies at 5:30?

owen: I'll coordinate table pickup at 5:15 and meet at loading dock.

priya: I'll help with setup and bingo station.

emily: Amazing team. Final call Friday 3pm if weather needs to change plan (we'll move inside to mezz lounge). See you Friday :tada:
